title: Desktop crash report: the body of POST /api/crash
description: GH-1414. What the packaged desktop build's main process sends when the game, one of its processes, or a JavaScript error in it fails. Built by tools/desktop/crash.mjs; the Worker's twin is packages/worker/src/crash-meta.ts, pinned to this file by crash-meta.test.ts. No minidump, no user text, no save data, no path outside the game, no URL query, no IP: a stack location is `web/<path>` (the page's own file), `asar/<path>` (the main process's own file), `node:<module>`, `<native>` or `<other>`. Rules a JSON Schema cannot state, enforced by the Worker: the body is at most 6144 UTF-8 bytes, and it is application/json.

launch.description: A random id made at launch and kept in memory only (never stored on the player's machine), so one launch's reports group together. It names no player and no machine.

gpu.description: The graphics card's FAMILY (gpuFamily: `NVIDIA RTX 30-series`, `Software (no GPU)`, `Unknown`), never the raw renderer string.

service.description: child_gone: the utility process's service name (`Network Service`, `Audio Service`, ...).

message.description: One line, scrubbed by rule (crash.mjs scrubMessage, the twin of the app's GH-1410 scrubber). The second lock: a message that still holds an email, a URL, a POSIX path of two segments or more, a Windows drive path or a UNC share is refused, whatever the client's scrubber did.
